title: Rest your hands
intro: Your hands have been busy. Give them a short rest. Skip any step you like.

steps.text: Lift your hands away from the keys and let them rest in your lap or on the desk.
Look at your hands for a moment, as if you were seeing them for the first time.
Let your fingers curl or open however they like. There is no right shape.
Let the chair or desk take the full weight of your arms.
Take one easy breath and notice whether your shoulders can sit a little lower.

closing: Hands rested. Pick up where you left off whenever you like.
